title: Night Curse
description: Locks you to the night time and makes you craft items to recover daylight and the use of beds.
body:
This datapack locks you to the night time, after some time to get prepared in the daylight. You must defeat mobs and craft items to recover hours of the daylight and get back the usage of the bed. Watch about this in further detail in my youtube video (not yet out).

Please credit me if you use this datapack in any sort of public or profitable manner.
